name: Practicing Devotion Builds Faith and Divine Energy
description: Each time a believer practises Devotion, there is a 1 in 10 chance their Faith rises by 1, and a separate 1 in 10 chance the village gains 1 Divine Energy: small amounts that add up over time. Practising Devotion is the game's Devotion skill check. It comes on 1 Honoring in 8 (half go to the statue, and 1 in 4 of those end in the check) and on every sermon to a Heathen, while playing and while catching up. The rolls come whether the check passes or fails; the Devotion skill, its odds and its gain stay the normal game's. **Honoring as a job needs the statue at its first stage or The Tribute Statue solved, as in the normal game.** **Faith never goes above 100 and Divine Energy never above the village's cap** (the game's own limits). **Believers only:** Heathens never practise Devotion, and the Heathen Doctor, the Heathen Chief (and the Retired Chief), the three Masters and the Heathen Mommy never get these rolls. **With "Faith Loss is Doubled/Gains Halved" also ticked, the Faith chance is halved to 1 in 20; the Divine Energy chance stays 1 in 10.** **Spirituality and Learning change how often the Devotion check passes, not these rolls.** **Works the same with every other patch and in every population mode.** **Not yet seen in a running game** (checked by emulation of the stock executable). The companion is "VVFP Devotion Faith.dll"; it never writes a save or a file.
behavior_changes: The skill check 0x46B270 with skill 5 (Devotion) -- Honoring's step-10 check (0x45CC9B queues it on rand(100) < 25 in the statue-spot half of behaviour 0xA0, 0x45CB70; run by 0x473B30 at 0x473C69 live and by the catch-up runner 0x46E020) and the sermon end's preacher check (0x468E9A) -- first makes two separate rolls for a believer (+0x1CEC 0) outside roles 12-17 (+0x1CFC): rand(10) < 1 adds 1 to Faith (+0x1CF0) when it is below 100 (a plain write; +1 from 1..99 never crosses the setter 0x467F90's conversion bounds); rand(10) < 1 adds 1 Divine Energy through the village manager's (read from the word 0x4DACE0 the getter 0x425950 keeps it in, never the getter) adder 0x424F80, which keeps it from 0 to the cap (+0x17D60). rand(10) is the game's 0x403660 (rand() % 10): 3,277 values in 32,768, 10.00% (the owner, 2026-11-21: "1 in 10 for both is good").

With Faith Loss is Doubled/Gains Halved ticked -- read at startup from that row's own executable byte, the Faith drift's food 8,000+ gain roll immediate at 0x46809B: 0x0A (rand(100) < 10) where the stock game has 0x14 -- the Faith roll is rand(20) < 1, 1,639 values in 32,768, 5.00% (the owner, 2026-11-21: that row halves this Faith chance too); the Divine Energy roll stays rand(10) < 1.
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the companion splices the one site at run time, only after verifying its stock bytes; registers and flags are as they were, and the stock check runs unchanged afterwards.
Every other skill's check, Heathens and roles 12-17 make no roll at all (the game's random numbers are drawn only for a believer's Devotion check).

The Devotion check's odds and gain, Spirituality, Learning, the Faith drift, Faith Loss is Doubled/Gains Halved's own rolls, preaching's own Faith for the Heathen, and the Divine Energy income and cap are the game's own.
Nothing is written but the villager's Faith and the village's Divine Energy; no file.

runtime_detours.routine: the skill check 0x46B270's entry (`sub esp, 0Ch / push ebx / push ebp`; thiscall on the villager, the skill at [esp+4]). For skill 5 (Devotion), a believer (+0x1CEC 0) outside roles 12-17 (+0x1CFC) gets two separate rand(10) < 1 rolls (the game's rand 0x403660): Faith (+0x1CF0) +1 below 100 (rand(20) < 1 when Faith Loss is Doubled/Gains Halved's byte 0x46809B is 0x0A); Divine Energy +1 through the village manager's (the word 0x4DACE0) adder 0x424F80 (kept at most the cap). Then the five bytes re-run and the stock check goes on at 0x46B275
runtime_detours.installed_by: VVFP Devotion Faith.dll, VvfpStartup (started by VVFP More Companions.dll, third word)
